Intel actually delivered - 250K Plus + 270K Plus Launch Analysis
▷ MY STORE - shirts, pint glasses & hoodies: http://paulshardware.net
Here's my launch analysis and review roundup for the new Intel Core Ultra 5 250K Plus and Core Ultra 7 270K Plus CPUs, for the existing LGA 1851 platform. Thanks to core count boosts, software upgrades and most importantly price cuts, these processors are very competitive in the 2026 PC hardware market - as long as you can find some DDR5 Memory.
